n: 4.5 Cu. Ft. Ultra Large Capacity Smart Front Load Washer
hl: Based on the cycle you select, LG 6Motion™ technology uses up to 6 different wash motions, each designed to get clothes cleaner and help them last longer.
Cleans Like Warm, Saves Like Cold
Saving energy doesn’t have to mean compromising on cleaning with the ColdWash™ option.
Built-in Intelligence Takes Out The Guesswork

Forget about endless sorting or toggling through cycles—built-in sensors use AI technology to detect fabric texture and load size, then automatically select the right wash motions, temperatures and more for advanced fabric care.
Backed by a 10-year limited warranty, the LG Direct Drive Motor delivers peace of mind with every load.
Go Big To Save Time And Get More Done
Say never again to never-ending piles of laundry—this ultra large capacity washer fits more clothes in every load and helps you power through laundry day in less time.
Unlike tubs made from porcelain or plastic, the LG NeveRust® Stainless Steel Tub avoids the chips and nicks that can snag fabrics and ruin clothing.
